name: Dustfall
description: Act 2, chapter `kindred` (STORY.md §16): the `dustfall` mission, escorting Marrow's survey team on Dunmore. A cold desert of long dunes, tallest in the dune sea to the west (`dune-sea`). The survey team waits by our Core (`survey-camp`). In the north-east a centuries-old Kindred hull lies under a long dune (`old-hull`: a wreck, 900 salvage), its broken hold open as a pit beside it: a nest grows in the hold, Burrowers guard it (`hold-burrowers`), and when `manifest-read` is set 12 Swarmers come out of it after the team (`hold-swarm`, attack: "defend the team on the way out"). A second nest far south-west; packs ×0.9; arid herds. Hooks: `marrow-manifest` and `marrow-grief` at `old-hull` (set `manifest-read` there), `keeper-song` choice, `failsafe-offer`. Still needs: Kindred units spawned as ours for the escort (they must survive), the dust storm, and the expedition package.
